szenen.text: Trump. Putin. Xi. Today in Shenzhen, China, the three most powerful men on the planet shook hands.
Trump and Putin, face to face for the first time since their Alaska meeting in August 2025.

foto.kopf: Xi rolls out the red carpet
foto.unter: He greeted Trump at the airport himself

szenen.text: Xi greeted Trump at the airport himself. Red carpet, honour guard, a military flyover. Putin had already spent two hours with Xi.
And tomorrow, Thursday, comes the first meeting ever of the presidents of the US, Russia and China. All three at one table.
On the table: nuclear weapons, Iran, the war in Ukraine, trade and AI. Ukraine and Europe are not in the room.
Our view: three men, one table, no Europe, no Ukraine. We think a new world order is being drawn right now. And markets will have to price it.
